issue.title: Routing treats a readable balance as "allowance not known": providers with balance but no usage windows (e.g. MiniMax Code) always show unknown
issue.body:
### What happened

The Routing page shows 「剩余额度未知」 ("remaining allowance not known yet") for providers whose usage API returns a **balance but no windows**, even though magpie successfully read the balance.

**Root cause (verified in source):** `internal/provider/routing.go:502`:

```go
for user, q := range readings {
    if q.Error != "" || len(q.Windows) == 0 {
        continue
    }
    all[user] = allowanceOf(q.Windows, time.Now())...
}
```

A reading with `Windows: []` but a non-empty `Balance` is skipped entirely, so the account is treated as unknown.

**Real-world example (MiniMax Code, from `~/.config/magpie/quotas.json`):**

```json
"minimax-code/minimax336627": {
  "quota": {
    "provider": "minimax-code",
    "plan": "Free",
    "user": "MiniMax336627",
    "windows": [],
    "balance": "1740.72 credits",
    "readAt": "2026-10-23T14:51:39.6466365+08:00"
  }
}
```

The balance **is** read (1,740.72 credits) and even displayed on the Usage/provider page, but the Routing page says 「剩余额度未知」 and the router weights the account as if nothing were known (it falls into the `learns` path).

### Suggested fix

When `len(q.Windows) == 0` but `q.Balance != ""`, still build an `Allowance` — either as an unwindowed meter keyed off the balance text (there is precedent: balance meters already render on the Usage page), or at minimum surface `Known: true` with the balance so routing doesn't treat a readable account as unknown.

Related but distinct: #2333 (expose holds via CLI/JSON), #3193 (custom provider balance meter switch). This issue is specifically about the `Windows == 0 → unknown` branch in the routing path.

comments.body:
Verified skygunner's fix for #3352 (4fb09e6b, branch `fix/issue-batch-1023pm`), checked out and re-tested on top of current main (ea9454d2). The reporter's diagnosis is implemented exactly as suggested ("at minimum" half): both allowance readers dropped a `Windows: []` reading whole, and both now take a successful, error-free reading that answers with a balance as **known, with an empty allowance** — the live `Allowances` reader in `internal/provider/routing.go` and the on-disk `lastAllowances` fallback in `internal/provider/quota_last.go` changed symmetrically, so a restart no longer flips the account back to not-known either. Map presence is what knownness means downstream (`weighRouted`'s `ok`, `AwaitAllowance`'s `knows`), and an empty allowance reads as unused, so routing weighs the account as known and unused instead of `Learns`/unknown — which is what the issue asks for. Error readings still know nothing, empty readings with no balance still say nothing, and the GUI balance meter is untouched, as the comment says.

Ablation holds: with only the two product files reverted to the parent (8b4ecbac) and the new tests kept, both tests fail with exactly the claimed message.

```
    allowance_balance_only_test.go:32: a balance-only reading left the account not known
--- FAIL: TestBalanceOnlyReadingKnowsTheAccount (0.02s)
    allowance_balance_only_test.go:53: the live balance-only reading left the account not known
--- FAIL: TestBalanceOnlyLiveReadingKnowsTheAccount (0.00s)
```

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| New tests targeted (`TestBalanceOnlyReadingKnowsTheAccount`, `TestBalanceOnlyLiveReadingKnowsTheAccount`), `-tags nogui` | PASS (`ok github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/provider`) |
| Ablation: both product files reverted to parent 8b4ecbac, tests kept | FAIL — both tests red, "left the account not known" (above) |
| Product files restored to 4fb09e6b | PASS again |
| Full `internal/provider` package, `-count=1 -tags nogui` | ok, 73.8s |
| Targeted `-race` (`TestBalanceOnly*` + `TestAllowances*`/`TestAllowance*` family + `TestKeepLast` + `TestAntigravity*`), `-tags nogui` | ok |
| Toolchain | go1.26.8 darwin/arm64 (go.mod: go 1.26.8), `GOTOOLCHAIN=auto` |
| `gofmt -l` on the three touched files | clean |
| `go vet -tags nogui ./internal/provider`, 3 runs | ok ×3 |
| `go build -tags nogui ./...`, 3 runs | ok ×3 (one pre-existing cgo warning in `internal/gui/trayimage_darwin.go` on darwin — warning only, unrelated to this change) |
| Applies to tip ea9454d2 | `git merge-tree` clean; real cherry-pick of 4fb09e6b onto ea9454d2 applies and the targeted tests pass there |

Reporter-scenario coverage, honestly: the live test drives the reader through `LoginUsageVia` with the reporter's exact reading (provider `minimax-code`, user `MiniMax336627`, `Windows: []`, `Balance: "1740.72 credits"`). The on-disk test seeds the same balance-only shape (no windows, same balance text) through the persisted store and reads `lastAllowances` back, but under the `antigravity` sandbox harness with a different account key rather than the `minimax-code` key — the branch under test is provider-agnostic, still worth noting. Not directly asserted: the gateway seat-ordering side (`Known`/`Learns` in `weighRouted`); what the tests pin is the provider-level knownness that side consumes.

No patch from me, no branch or commits opened for this — the fix is skygunner's and it is complete; deferring entirely.

Verified with AI assistance (GLM-5.3-Flash via ZCode); I've read the diff and re-ran the checks above.

issue.title: usage: a prepaid wallet has no way to say "how much is left" — a window forces a fake share, no window makes the account unknown

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## TL;DR

A provider that sells **prepaid credit** — a wallet — cannot be described by the current usage contract:

- **With windows**, `used` must be a share of a periodic allowance. A wallet has no such denominator, so any `used` we send is fabricated.
- **Without windows**, `routedAllowance` returns not-ok, `weighed()` leaves `Known` unset, and the Routing page says 「剩余额度未知」 — the account ranks after every known one (#3650).
- **`aside: true` does not help**: `allowanceOf()` skips those windows whole, with the same result.

What is missing is a **balance-shaped reading**: "this much is left", in a unit, with no percentage. Two fields would carry it — `QuotaWindow.Balance` and `routes.Seat.Left`.

## The provider (real numbers, 2026-10-28)

SuperMagic (超级麦吉 / MagiCrew), community plugin `magpie-magicrew-auth`.

`GET /api/v1/quota/points/total` answers:

```json
{"total_points": 6291,
 "expiring_quota_details": [
   {"remaining_points": 185, "expires_at": "2026-10-28 23:59:59"},
   {"remaining_points": 100, "expires_at": "2026-11-26 16:45:13"},
   {"remaining_points": 956, "expires_at": "2027-11-03 19:11:01"}],
 "organization_limit_points": null,
 "user_limit_points": null,
 "next_cycle_grant": null}
```

- No total, no consumed: `*_limit_points` are `null` on personal accounts.
- The ledger endpoint `POST /api/v1/quota/points/records/queries` answers **HTTP 500** on both sites (five body shapes tried), so "how much was spent" is not readable either.
- The only fixed number is the daily login gift — **200 points/day (CN), 50 (intl)** — which expires at 23:59:59 the same day.

## What the plugin tried, and what magpie did

| plugin sends | magpie | result |
|---|---|---|
| `aside: true, used: 0, display: "6,291 积分"` | `allowanceOf()` skips Aside/Text whole; none left → `routedAllowance` not ok → `weighed()` leaves `Known` unset | Routing page 「剩余额度未知」; the account ranks after every known one |
| `used: 0, display: "6,291 积分"` (no `limit`) | known, but routing's `quota()` shows the count only when `limit > 0` | row reads `0% used`, no figure |
| `used: 0, amount: 0, limit: 6291` | known, figure shown | percentage is `0 / 6291` — a tautology (denominator = remainder); the "fake share" of #3353 |

## What it costs the router

`routes.Seat` carries `Used float64` (a 0–100 share), `Soon []time.Time`, `Lapse`, `Pace`, … — **nothing that says how much is left**.

- **`pace`**: `(100 - used) / hours until resetsAt`. A wallet has no `resetsAt` and its `used` is always 0, so every account of this provider gets **the same pace**. 6,291 points and 750 points are indistinguishable.
- **`smart`**: the fine tier is ordered by `Soon` (`Allowance.Renewal`, which does fold `runsOutAt` in), then `Lapse` — it can say *whose points expire first*, never *who has more left*.

Measured on 4 accounts: 1,363 / 1,693 / 6,291 / 750 points; earliest expiries 178 / 29 / 29 / 372 days out. Under `smart` all four tie on `Soon` whenever the expiry days match; under `pace` they are **exactly** identical.

## Suggested shape

**`QuotaWindow`**

```go
// Balance is how much of this allowance is left, in Unit — a reading of a
// prepaid balance, with no share to tell (Used stays nil for it).
Balance *float64 `json:"balance,omitempty"`
```

`allowanceOf` keeps such a window (`l.Balance = *w.Balance`), so `Known` is true, without inventing a `Used`.

**`routes.Seat`**

```go
// Left is the absolute remainder in the provider's own unit: comparable
// within one provider, 0 when the vendor doesn't say.
Left float64
```

Filled from the windows' `Balance` (or the fullest window's `Amount`/`Of` when the vendor does count).

**Ordering**: `smart` / `pace` fall back to `Left` (most first) when shares are unknown or equal. A prepaid provider then becomes rankable by both dimensions that matter: *who runs out first* (`runsOutAt`) and *who has the most left* (`balance`).

## Today's plugin-side workaround (for reference)

Three windows, so the account is at least known and carries `runsOutAt`:

1. **今日积分** — today's batch, **real percentage** (denominator = the 200/50 daily gift), `resetsAt` = next midnight.
2. **限时积分** — the rest of the expiring batches, `used: 0`, `limit` = current remainder, `runsOutAt` = earliest.
3. **永久积分** — `total − Σexpiring`, `aside`, display only.

That is the best the current contract allows — and it still cannot express "how much".

## Related

- #3428 — the seat knows *when* but not *how much* is lost (`w.RunsOut` dropped in `allowanceOf`). This issue is the same gap one layer up: the seat also cannot see *how much is left at all*.
- #3352 — a `Windows: []` reading with a balance is dropped entirely, so the account is unknown.
- #3353 — a window that never moves reads as `used: 0` and distorts smart ordering.
- #3650 — a window without `used` becomes text + aside, no share.

Happy to send a PR for the two fields if the shape looks right — I can test it against this provider directly.

issue.title: provider: /api/usage/token default reads token-scoped total_available, so unlimited_quota tokens show a negative balance

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### What happened

I added a custom provider (`arm`, `https://ai.armclouding.com`) — a new-api style relay. Magpie displayed its balance as **$-4.33** while the account actually held **$106.44**.

The token in use has `unlimited_quota: true`, so the **token-scoped** `total_available` goes negative once usage exceeds the token's grant. That number is not the account balance.

`GET https://ai.armclouding.com/api/usage/token` (with the provider key) returns:

```json
{
  "code": true,
  "data": {
    "total_available": -2192414,
    "total_granted": 0,
    "total_used": 2192414,
    "unlimited_quota": true,
    "user_quota": {
      "total_available": 53222012,
      "total_used": 6778929
    }
  }
}
```

`-2192414 / 500000 = -4.38` — that is exactly what magpie printed. The account balance is `53222012 / 500000 = 106.44`.

### Root cause

For `/api/usage/token`, magpie's built-in default is

```js
if (path === "/api/usage/token") return "$data.total_available / 500000";
```

which reads the **token-scoped** `total_available`. On new-api / one-api relays that issue `unlimited_quota: true` tokens, that field is a token allowance rather than an account balance, and it can legitimately go negative.

The account-level figure is present in the very same response, under `user_quota.total_available`.

### Suggested fix

When a `/api/usage/token` response carries `unlimited_quota: true` (or simply has `user_quota` present), prefer the account-level field, e.g. `$data.user_quota.total_available / 500000`.

This looks like the same class of problem as #3352 (*"Routing treats a readable balance as 'allowance not known'"*) — in both cases the built-in default picks the wrong field out of a payload that actually contains the right one.

### Workaround (works today)

```bash
magpie provider set arm "balance.path=\$data.user_quota.total_available / 500000"
```

After that the provider page shows the correct figure.

### Environment

- magpie `0.1.3084` (windows-amd64)
- provider: custom, `anthropic` base API, `https://ai.armclouding.com`
- upstream: new-api (payload shape above, quota unit `500000`)

issue.title: [Feature Request] Routing「账号与密钥」支持可选常显尝试 / 应答 / 失败计数

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 需求概述

希望在 **路由 → 账号与密钥（Routing → Accounts and keys）** 增加一个**可选的「始终显示请求统计」开关**，让用户决定是否直接展示每个账号的 `尝试 / 应答 / 失败 / 最近应答`。

**默认保持现有紧凑布局（开关关闭）**，不要求回滚或改变所有用户现在的界面；仅当用户主动开启时，额度/状态文本与请求计数同时显示。

## 背景与影响

Magpie 升级后，在 Windows 桌面端：

- 旧界面会直接显示 `尝试 N / 应答 N / N 失败 / 最近应答`。
- 新界面中，部分 Codex / OpenAI 账号显示 **「剩余额度未知」** 时，统计行不再常显，必须悬停整行才能看到。
- 同一页面里，没有额外状态文本的 API Key 行仍可显示 `尝试 0 / 应答 0`。

对多账号轮换或排查上游失败的用户来说，请求次数和最后一次成功应答比额度未知更需要经常扫一眼。悬停在大量账号、窄窗口或触屏场景下较不方便。

### 已确认的改版来源（不是新出现的数据丢失 Bug）

已通过相邻 tag 的源码确认：**v0.1.2958** 尚无隐藏规则，**v0.1.2959** 开始包含该规则。

引入提交：[11d9d0a — routing: each account one calm cell in Accounts and keys](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/commit/11d9d0a3a52a0060e93dc548fb5e3a7bce7bc1a9)

该提交明确是为了回应用户对卡片过于杂乱的反馈，将统计和时间移入 hover。这是合理的布局取舍，因此建议以**用户可选显示模式**兼顾两种需求，而非移除新的设计。

- [v0.1.2959 Release](https://github.com/yetone/magpie-releases/releases/tag/v0.1.2959)

### 环境

- 问题观察时 Magpie：`0.1.3122`；在后续检查的 `v0.1.3127` / `main` 中该行为仍存在。
- ChatGPT/Codex Desktop：`26.1103.31037`
- Windows 桌面端

## 期望交互

建议在「账号与密钥」标题旁或路由页面显示设置中提供类似：

- [ ] **始终显示请求统计**（默认关闭）

| 模式 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| **关闭（默认）** | 保持现在的紧凑卡片布局，有状态文本时将统计保留在 hover 中 |
| **开启** | 即使存在额度/状态文本，仍直接显示 `尝试 / 应答 / 失败 / 最近应答`；无统计的账号可以显示 0，沿用现有统计口径 |

用户主动开启后的示意：

```text
Codex · <account>     pro
剩余额度未知
尝试 148   应答 113   35 失败   最近应答 15:03
```

建议记住开关选择，并在页面重新打开时保留。统计口径不变，不涉及修改网关、数据库、鉴权或额度获取。

## 源码定位与实现建议

`internal/gui/assets/plugins/routing/client.js` 仍生成完整 `.tally` 内容：

https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.3122/internal/gui/assets/plugins/routing/client.js#L4612-L4623

但在第 4697–4703 行，已有状态文本时为卡片增加 `said` 类：

```js
const said = !!st || (ws.length > 0 && !figure);
row.classList.toggle("said", said && !act);
```

CSS 则隐藏该统计行：

```css
/* with a line of its own, how it fares is on hover; one to fix says it */
.rt-act.said > .tally { display: none; }
```

源码：[routing.css](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.3127/internal/gui/assets/plugins/routing/routing.css#L524)

**建议：** 用局部页面级开关控制是否应用此隐藏规则（例如增加页面容器 class）；开关关闭时保持现状，开启时允许 `.rt-act.said > .tally` 显示。无需修改现有计数逻辑。具体配置入口以维护者现有设计规范为准。

回归测试可以覆盖：

1. 默认模式：有额度/状态文本时仍为当前紧凑布局，统计可通过 hover 查看。
2. 开启模式：状态行 + `tried/answered/failures/last answered` 同时可见；失败及未知额度账户均可见。
3. 开关切换和重新进入页面后选择保留；折叠账号、长列表及窄屏下布局不遮挡。

## 相关 Issue（非重复）

- #3351：统计范围（最近请求 vs 当日请求）问题，本需求只涉及**可见性**。
- #3352：余额已读取但路由显示额度未知，属于**额度/路由**问题。
- https://github.com/yetone/magpie-releases/issues/49：账号额度未知，未涉及此显示开关。

## 截图

旧版可见统计、新版隐藏统计的对比现象：

![Routing page screenshot](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/231dae5c-1bee-44a0-bafe-5bd4f0acf335)

issue.title: provider: a balance field's part may be a time, shown as its date (fix branch ready)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Branch: [`apple-ouyang/magpie fix/balance-field-time`](https://github.com/apple-ouyang/magpie/tree/fix/balance-field-time), one commit, [`ec4e245`](https://github.com/apple-ouyang/magpie/commit/ec4e24569c97816e787672a2dda4665cca6496ac), on origin/main `a095e4027`. `gh pr create` is refused (`apple-ouyang does not have the correct permissions to execute CreatePullRequest`), which is the collaborators-only rule in `docs/contributors.md`, so it comes here.

```
git fetch https://github.com/apple-ouyang/magpie fix/balance-field-time && git cherry-pick ec4e245
```

## The gap

A custom provider's balance field reads numbers and only numbers (`readBalanceOne`, `internal/provider/balance.go`). A panel that tells a reset as a timestamp comes to the card as money with two decimals:

```
p  balance   重置 1796832000000.00 left
```

That is #3011 and #5660. Both ask for the same thing: a way to say *this path is a time, not an amount*, converted for display.

## The change

A part of the field ending in `@` is a time:

```
magpie provider set my-relay balance.path='剩余: $left; 重置: quota.resetsAt@'
```

It reads a Unix time in seconds, or in milliseconds past `1e11`, as a JSON number or a string of one; RFC 3339 text; or a date alone (`2026-12-10`, midnight local, which #5660's reporter also wanted). It shows as the date — today's as its time of day, on this computer's clock:

| path | reply | card |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `quota.resetsAt@` | `1796832000` | `Dec 10` |
| `q.resetsAt@` | `1796832000000` | `Dec 10` |
| `q.resetsAt@` | `"2026-12-10T00:00:00+08:00"` | `Dec 10` |
| `q.resetsAt@` | `"2026-12-10"` | `Dec 10` |
| `q.resetsAt@; n: q.n` | `{"q":{"resetsAt":"nope","n":5}}` | `— · n 5.00` |

A number too small to be a time (a count of `5`, the epoch) is refused rather than shown as `Jan 1 1970`: a field naming a time names a reset ahead. `$` and `%` are read after `@`, so neither applies to a time part.

## What it does not do

Display only. Routing reads a key's windows, never its balance — `routedAllowance` returns nothing when `len(q.Windows) == 0` — so a card that now says a reset date still doesn't rest the key at it. That is #3352 (a balance-only reading is an allowance not known) plus #6406 (one `BalanceURL` per provider, so a cap and its reset in two queries can't both be read). This change is worth having without either, for a provider whose reset is in the same reply as its amounts; it does not stand in for them.

#3011's other ask — mapping a part to a standard quota window with a meter — is #6273's `% resets <path> every <span>`, not this.

## Verification

New: `TestBalanceFieldTime` in `internal/provider/balance_parts_test.go` — seconds, milliseconds, RFC 3339, a date alone, today's time of day, a missing time beside a good amount, and the refusals (`n@` of 5, `quota.day@x`, `@` with no path, `"not a date"`).

```
gofmt -l internal/provider/balance.go internal/provider/balance_parts_test.go internal/gui/core_budget_test.go   # no output
go vet ./internal/provider/ ./internal/gui/ ./internal/cli/                                                      # clean
go test ./internal/provider/ -count=1                                                                            # 2561 passed
go test ./internal/provider/ -run 'TestBalance' -count=1                                                         # 19 passed
go test ./internal/gui/ -run 'TestCoreScriptBudget' -count=1                                                     # ok
go build -tags nogui -o /tmp/magpie-time-test .                                                                  # builds
```

End to end, against a local mock answering each shape above, through the built binary:

```
sec  quota.resetsAt@   -> p  balance  Dec 10 left
ms   q.resetsAt@       -> p  balance  Dec 10 left
iso  q.resetsAt@       -> p  balance  Dec 10 left
day  q.resetsAt@       -> p  balance  Dec 10 left
bad  q.resetsAt@; n: q.n -> p  balance  — · n 5.00 left
```

`internal/cli` has two failures, `TestUpdateRestartsTheGatewayItFindsWithoutMagpieAddr` and `TestUpdateFindsAMagpieThatWroteNoRecord`, which fail the same with the change stashed: they read a live magpie on 3425.

Not run: the GUI suite beyond `TestCoreScriptBudget`, and no real vendor of mine answers a reset beside its amounts, so nothing beyond the mock was exercised.

## Also in the commit

The Balance field's hint names the syntax in `zh`, `zh-TW`, `ja` and `de`; `magpie provider add` lists it among its examples; `docs/reference.md`'s `balance_path` row says it. The core script budget carries the 125 bytes the hint costs, with the reason in `core_budget_test.go`.

issue.title: 自定义供应商额度卡：支持重置时间格式化与标准窗口呈现（Unix 时间戳目前显示为金额数字）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 问题

macOS Magpie 0.1.1290 的「用量 → 概览 → 额度」中，自定义供应商的原生 balance 卡片能显示多个百分比，但无法将重置时间格式化为日期，导致卡片出现 `1792480200.00` 这样的数字。希望自定义供应商额度卡也能像内置订阅一样显示窗口、进度和可读的重置时间。

这是 Magpie 自带的自定义 provider/balance 卡片，不是自定义 UI 插件。

## 可复现数据

本地 vm2api 的 `GET /v1/usage` 返回下列结构（使用已有 provider API key；这里不含凭据）：

```json
{
  "unit": "percent_used",
  "five_hour": {"utilization": 54, "status": "allowed", "resets_at": "1792480200"},
  "seven_day": {"utilization": 18, "status": "allowed", "resets_at": "1792519200"},
  "source": "extra"
}
```

Magpie 通过原生配置读取：

```sh
magpie provider set vm2api \
  balance=http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/usage \
  'balance.path=5小时剩余: (1 - five_hour.utilization / 100) %; 5小时重置: five_hour.resets_at; 周剩余: (1 - seven_day.utilization / 100) %; 周重置: seven_day.resets_at'
```

`GET /v1/magpie/quotas/cards` 正确保留了分项：

```json
{
  "provider": "vm2api",
  "windows": [],
  "balanceParts": [
    {"label": "5小时剩余", "text": "46%", "percent": 46},
    {"label": "5小时重置", "text": "1792480200.00"},
    {"label": "周剩余", "text": "82%", "percent": 82},
    {"label": "周重置", "text": "1792519200.00"}
  ]
}
```

## 实际显示

- 百分比可视化正常，但两个重置时间原样显示为 `1792480200.00`、`1792519200.00`。
- 多个窗口只能作为 balance 分项堆在一起，重置时间与窗口缺少内置订阅卡片的关联和日期呈现。
- 自定义分项写的是「剩余」时，通用 percent 颜色不理解该语义（数值很高也可能走 >=90% 的警示色）。

## 期望

提供显式的字段配置或格式化能力，不依赖猜测字段名：

1. 支持将 Unix 秒/毫秒、ISO 日期转换为本地重置时间，最好附距重置还有多久。
2. 支持把自定义响应映射为标准额度窗口（名称、已用/剩余、重置时间），让原生卡片的布局与内置订阅一致。
3. 百分比能明确指定 used/remaining，进度及警示颜色遵循相应语义。

如果已有推荐配置可以表达上述内容，也希望能补充到文档。

相关实现：`internal/provider/balance.go` 的 `readBalanceOne` 把纯数值路径作为金额格式化；`balanceParts` 没有时间类型。目前读取和百分比都能成功，缺口主要在自定义字段的类型表达及原生呈现。

issue.title: [Feature Request] 自定义供应商余额字段支持格式化 Unix 时间戳

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
使用场景

我在 Magpie 里接了一个 vm2api 供应商，用 GET /v1/usage 查询 Claude 账号的 5 小时和 7 天额度。剩余百分比可以正常显示，但重置时间在「用量」卡片里显示成了 1794107400.00 这样的数字，每次都要手动换算。

复现步骤

  1. 添加一个 vm2api 自定义供应商，将「余额查询地址」设为 GET https://<vm2api-host>/v1/usage。

  2. 在「余额字段」粘贴下面这行。

    5h: five_hour.utilization / 100%; 7d: seven_day.utilization / 100%; 5h重置: five_hour.resets_at; 7d重置: seven_day.resets_at

  3. 保存后打开「用量」页，查看该供应商的卡片。

实际表现

5 小时剩余 79%，7 天剩余 30%，两个百分比都能正常显示。重置时间显示为带两位小数的 Unix 时间戳。

额度窗口 | 当前显示 | 对应的北京时间 -- | -- | -- 5 小时 | 1794107400.00 | 2026-11-08 11:10 7 天 | 1794283200.00 | 2026-11-10 12:00

希望支持的行为

希望能在「余额字段」里显式指定某个字段是 Unix 秒级时间戳，让 Magpie 按本地时区显示日期和时间。这样可以在同一张用量卡片上直接看到还剩多少额度、几点重置。只对显式指定的字段做转换，现有的金额和百分比字段继续按原格式显示。
